note: A seeded evening: ten conversations, 200 turns, German and English, in the shapes a VRChat lobby produces. Written by hand rather than sampled from a real archive, because the gate needs cases whose ground truth is not in dispute — and because a bench that quotes a real evening cannot be committed. Ids are stable and are what the cases cite; `t` is the local clock the model is shown.
